title: NBA Cup final moves from Las Vegas to the Hoosiers gym
excerpt: The 2026 NBA Cup final will be played at Indianapolis' historic Hinkle Fieldhouse on 11 December, with more than US$500,000 a player for the winners.
content_html:
The NBA's in-season tournament is leaving the Las Vegas Strip for one of basketball's most storied venues. The 2026 Emirates NBA Cup championship will be played at Hinkle Fieldhouse in Indianapolis on 11 December (US time).

The college gym is best known as a setting for the 1986 film Hoosiers. The first three Cup finals were all played in Las Vegas, and the league says it plans to take future finals to iconic basketball arenas.

How the tournament works

Group play ran on designated Cup nights from 30 October to 27 November. The 30 teams were split into six groups of five, three in each conference. Each group winner goes through, along with one wild card per conference, the best-performing runner-up.

That produces an eight-team single-elimination bracket. Before the final night of group games, only the Dallas Mavericks had secured a place, and ten teams had been knocked out, including the Oklahoma City Thunder and Milwaukee Bucks.

A crowded final night

The last round of group games was packed with deciders. The Spurs, beaten 116-111 by the Portland Trail Blazers on Wednesday, needed to beat the Los Angeles Lakers to stay alive. In the East, the defending champion Knicks went into their game against the Miami Heat still able to qualify after a 121-102 win over the Cleveland Cavaliers.

What's changed

For the first time, the semi-finals are not in Las Vegas. Quarter-finals on 4 and 5 December and semi-finals on 8 and 9 December will be played on the higher seed's home court.

Every knockout game except the final also counts in the regular-season standings.

What's at stake

The prize money per player is:

  • Champions: US$514,971
  • Runners-up: US$205,988
  • Semi-final losers: US$102,994
  • Quarter-final losers: US$51,497

The team to beat

The New York Knicks are the reigning Cup champions. They beat the San Antonio Spurs 124-113 in last year's final, then beat the Spurs again in the 2026 NBA Finals. That made them the first franchise to win both trophies in the same season, and the first time the two Cup finalists had met in the Finals.

Australian fans can follow the knockout rounds over the first fortnight of December. US evening tip-offs fall during the late morning and early afternoon on Australia's east coast.
